## Overview

IriusRisk documentation describes creating threat models from diagrams, questionnaires, templates, infrastructure-as-code inputs, and AI-assisted inputs. It presents these inputs as ways to produce architecture models and generated security findings for later review.

## Applicability

| Axis | Rating | Why |
|---|---|---|
| Security | core | First-party threat-model creation and finding-generation workflow. |
| Cryptography | none | Cryptographic design is not the document’s focus. |
| This project | core | Evidence for DEC-001, DEC-003, DEC-006, and R-018. |

The source is useful as product-design evidence, not as an independent evaluation of product behavior.
